launch_gates: Review and sign off each Master YEAR+ROW+NAME+PLACE identity against latest public confirmed rows; never auto-inherit 2026 starts into 2027.
Independently review the venue-to-settlement-point displacement, ambiguity and route start roles, especially SZTL adult versus children.
Place points and event positions must stay separate: no promotion from a reviewed place to an exact race start.
Explicitly set reviewed entries one-by-one in a versioned static index with provenance and a named reviewed sign-off; no batch flag flips from this file.
Check SL/EN attribution and zero-match partial-coverage warning, especially 10 km edge cases and mobile UX.
Run full CI and a production-mode build with no private test instrumentation; check that no edit leaks original coordinates to URL/storage/analytics.
Agree a meaningful minimum geographic/edition coverage and expected benefit for pilot; otherwise choose internal pilot only.
Verify live current Master+API and index join (year,master_row) and Source->Master identity; no writes to STK Master or derived tables.
Prepare one-commit rollback, dry-run release checklist, and explicit approval before merge/deploy; check production SL/EN/mobile/API after rollout.
